name: Libitina
source:
A witch who represents the organization Ooze, devoted to hunting down saints.

She is a girl of few expressions, seemingly apathetic and detached. Opposes the heroine and her companions in her quest to create a world where witches—and the enemies of saints—can be acknowledged and accepted.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
